data_provenance.preparation: Harte pitch set must contain exactly one complete major/minor triad; discard additional tones and bass; canonical roots; common [0,min(end)] coverage; no padding, shifts or internal exclusions
data_provenance.selection: first three filenames in lexical order with fully projectable labels, strict continuous input and endpoint spread <=0.1 s; no scores used

FK2.description: Published MIREX 2018 FK2 output; evaluated after declared major/minor projection and common-coverage preparation

JLCX1.description: Published MIREX 2018 JLCX1 output; evaluated after declared major/minor projection and common-coverage preparation
